en.title: Adverbs of frequency
en.summary: Adverbs of frequency tell how often something happens.

paragraphs: Adverbs of frequency tell how often something happens. They answer the question how often? From the most to the least often they are always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, seldom and never. Other expressions, such as every day and twice a week, are used for exact frequency.

They go before the main verb but after be. With an auxiliary, they go between the auxiliary and the main verb. Sometimes, usually and often can also begin a sentence. Never already means not ever, so do not add not.

blocks.html:
PositionExample
before the main verbShe often walks.
after beHe is always late.
with an auxiliaryI have never been there.
start (for emphasis)Sometimes we eat out.
end (with often)We go there quite often.

paragraphs: Always means 100 percent of the time, usually about 90, often about 70, sometimes about 50 and never 0. Hardly ever and rarely are close to zero. This scale helps you to choose the right word.
Phrases such as every day, once a month and three times a year usually go at the end of the sentence: I visit my parents twice a year. We ask for them with How often?

items: Wrong: **I drink always tea.** Right: **I always drink tea.**
Wrong: **He doesn't never come.** Right: **He never comes.**
Wrong: **She always is late.** Right: **She is always late.**

ro.title: Adverbe de frecvență
ro.summary: Adverbele de frecvență arată cât de des facem o acțiune în viața de zi cu zi.

paragraphs: Adverbele de frecvență arată cât de des facem o acțiune. Ele determină un verb. Exemple comune sunt: mereu, de obicei, uneori, rar și niciodată.
În limba română, aceste adverbe stau de obicei după verb. Ele pot sta și la începutul propoziției. Cuvântul „niciodată” cere mereu negația „nu” înainte de verb.

blocks.html:
AdverbFrecvențăExemplu
mereu100%Citesc **mereu** seara.
de obicei80%**De obicei** mă trezesc devreme.
des70%Mergem **des** la teatru.
uneori50%**Uneori** gătesc paste.
rar20%El călătorește **rar** singur.
niciodată0%Nu întârzii **niciodată** la serviciu.
